async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Select 'Approved' in the status filter combobox
    status_combobox = page.get_by_role('row', name='Any undefined  undefined ').get_by_role('combobox').nth(3)
    await status_combobox.select_option('Approved')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    # Wait for the page to reload after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Additional wait for content to update
    # Read the value from the 'of X' textbox to get the count
    count_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='of 1')
    count_value = await count_textbox.input_value()
    # The count_value might be like 'of 5', so extract the number
    # Assuming it's in the format 'of X', where X is the total count
    total_count = count_value.split(' ')[-1]  # Get the last part after space
    # Return the total count as a string
    return total_count
